title: Ants — state (engine → model)
description: Everything a model needs to choose this turn's moves, and nothing else. Authored and published by the game developer for model developers; the platform never loads it. Coordinates are [row, col], zero-indexed, row-major, and the map wraps on both axes. Owners are OBSERVER-RELATIVE: 0 is always you.

size.description: [rows, cols]. Varies by preset, so it is sent; the adapter needs it to reshape the water run-lengths.

mine.description: YOUR ants. THE ACTION ARRAY IS POSITIONALLY ALIGNED WITH THIS LIST: action[i] is the move for mine[i]. Ordering is stable within a turn and carries no meaning across turns. Present even when empty.

foes.description: Enemy ants currently visible to you. Fog is applied by the engine, so this list IS what you can see.

hills.description: Hills you know about, standing or razed-and-visible.

rle.description: Flat [value, run, value, run, …] over cells in row-major order. Values are 0 or 1. THE RUNS MUST SUM TO rows*cols — a cross-field invariant JSON Schema cannot express, so conformance checks it.

water.description: KNOWN water only, accumulated as the map is explored. Note the consequence of there being no visibility mask: a 0 means 'not known to be water', which conflates 'known empty' with 'never seen'. A model that cares about the exploration frontier must carry that in its recurrent state.
